items.source_title: A Prehistory of DAOs — gnosis guild 🪐
items.title: Value of Peer-to-Peer Institutions
items.content: During this crest of the hype cycle, we could see relationships forged by new peer-to-peer institutions take root underneath.
items.explanation: This value emphasizes the importance of peer-to-peer institutions in fostering relationships and facilitating interactions.
items.context: The content discusses the rise of blockchain technology and the potential for peer-to-peer institutions to play a significant role in the digital landscape.

items.source_title: A Prehistory of DAOs — gnosis guild 🪐
items.title: Value of Provable Uniqueness in Blockchain
items.content: The utility of provable uniqueness also extends to types of relations beyond direct economic exchange.
items.explanation: This value highlights the importance of provable uniqueness, a feature of blockchain technology, in facilitating not just economic transactions, but also other types of relationships.
items.context: The content discusses the unique features of blockchain technology and their potential applications in various domains.

items.source_title: Decentralized parties: The future of on-chain governance
items.title: Democratic Participation and Self-Governance
items.content: What if they could elevate democracy to a new level, creating a self-governance system where everyone would have a say?
items.explanation: The value emphasized here is democratic participation and self-governance. The author believes in the importance of everyone having a say in governance.
items.context: This value is highlighted in the discussion on the potential of distributed ledger technologies in improving voting systems and creating a self-governance system.
items.implementation: The author does not provide specific implementation details for this value.

items.source_title: IXO Spatial Web Platform for Intelligent Systems
items.title: Promoting the Green Economy
items.content: fuelling the Green Economy in emerging markets.
items.explanation: The value here is the promotion of the Green Economy. This indicates a commitment to sustainable development and environmental stewardship.
items.context: This value is reflected in the platform's policies and goals, which aim to promote the Green Economy in emerging markets.
items.implementation: This value is implemented through the platform's financing and scaling of access to modern energy cooking devices, and its matching of young people to opportunities in the Green Economy.

items.source_title: The End of Nation-States - by Tomas Pueyo
items.title: Importance of Community and Belonging
items.content: A sense of place/team/tribe seems to be an important part of the human psyche. That rootedness runs deep. The Anywheres will need that sense as much as others. Where will they get it?
items.explanation: The author values the sense of community and belonging, considering it a fundamental part of human nature. The author questions how this need for rootedness will be met in a world where traditional nation-states have fallen.
items.context: This value is presented in the context of discussing the potential fall of nation-states and the rise of a more global, decentralized society.

items.source_title: Against Scarcity - by David Phelps - Three quarks
items.title: Democratization of simulated real estate
items.content: Recreating the physical world online, decentralized universes like Upland serve the noble purpose of democratizing simulated real estate for the average Joes of the world.
items.explanation: The value here is the democratization of access to simulated real estate in virtual worlds, making it accessible to the average person.
items.context: This value is discussed in the context of virtual worlds like Upland, which aim to democratize access to simulated real estate.
items.implementation: The author provides the example of Upland, a virtual world that embodies this value by making simulated real estate accessible to the average person.

items.title: Trustworthy Data Exchange
items.content: JLINC gives all parties both transparency and control before and after they share their data, thus providing a platform for truly trustworthy data exchange.
items.explanation: This value emphasizes the importance of trust in data exchange. It suggests that data exchange should be conducted in a way that is transparent and gives control to all parties involved, thereby fostering trust.
items.context: This value is central to the JLINC protocol, which is designed to provide a platform for trustworthy data exchange.
items.implementation: JLINC implements this value through its protocol that automates permissioned control of data after it is shared.
